description: This file contains functions for verifying the URL resolution for API endpoints related to users, primarily for debugging and testing purposes within a development environment. It constructs expected URLs for the '/api/users' endpoint, optionally with organization ID overrides, and logs verification details.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the '/api/users' endpoint, optionally simulating an organization ID override, and performs validation of query parameters.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: A helper function that calls verifyUsersUrlResolution with a preset organization ID ('T0015') for testing and logging purposes.
